caption: Day 6 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Chicken Fajitas Orzo 🌮 Ingredients Chicken * 1 chicken breast * 1 tbsp olive oil * 1 tbsp chicken fajita seasoning * 1 tsp lemon juice * ½ tsp oregano * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper Orzo * 1 tbsp butter * 1 small onion * 1 yellow bell pepper * 2 cups orzo * 4 cups boiling water * ½ cup heavy cream * 1 tbsp fresh parsley Directions Marinate the chicken → cook until golden → sauté the onion and bell pepper → add the orzo and seasonings → pour in boiling water and cook until tender → stir in the heavy cream → return the chicken and finish with fresh parsley ✨ A creamy one-pan family dinner that's perfect for busy weeknights 🤍 If you want even more recipes like this, MunchMind has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, plus weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you and grocery lists to make the whole week easier 🤍 Find it in my bio ✨ #familydinner #onepotdinner #toddlermealideas #toddlerrecipes #easyfamilyrecipes
